tagline: Link your Google Calendar meetings with Zoom calls automatically
metaTitle: Google Calendar + Zoom Integration: Zoom Links on Events
metaDescription: Never paste a meeting link again. GAIA adds a Zoom link to each calendar event, reminds you to prep, and prompts follow-ups after the call. See the setup steps.
intro:
Creating video meetings and adding them to calendar events is a small but persistent friction point. You create an event, generate a link, paste it in, and hope everyone finds it. When meetings get rescheduled, the link sometimes changes. When new attendees are added, they may miss it.

GAIA automates the connection between Google Calendar and Zoom. New events get Zoom links added automatically. Meeting prep arrives in your preferred channel before each call. Post-meeting notes capture what happened. The administrative overhead of video meeting management disappears.

useCases.title: Auto-add Zoom links to calendar events
useCases.description: When you create an event with external attendees, GAIA automatically generates a meeting and adds the join link to the event so attendees always have the video call details.

useCases.title: Pre-meeting prep reminders
useCases.description: Five minutes before each event with a video link, GAIA sends the join link, agenda, and attendee list to your preferred channel so you're never scrambling to find the meeting details.

useCases.title: Post-call follow-up prompts
useCases.description: After a call ends, GAIA sends a prompt to capture meeting notes and action items while context is fresh, with a structured template ready to fill in.

useCases.title: Rescheduled meeting link management
useCases.description: When an event is rescheduled, GAIA checks whether the meeting needs updating and keeps the event's video link current so attendees always have working join details.

useCases.title: Meeting recording notifications
useCases.description: When a recording is available for an event, GAIA notifies attendees with the recording link so they can review it without searching through Zoom's recording library.

howItWorks.step: Connect Google Calendar and Zoom to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your Google Calendar and Zoom account. Configure which event types should get video links added automatically.
Choose which events generate meetings, by attendee count, calendar, or event name keywords. Configure your preferred prep notification channel.

howItWorks.step: Meetings run smoothly from start to finish
howItWorks.description: GAIA handles link creation, event updates, pre-meeting prep, and post-meeting follow-up so you focus entirely on the conversation.

faqs.question: Can GAIA use my existing settings (waiting room, passcode) when creating meetings?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA creates meetings with your account's default settings. You can also configure specific settings per event type — like enabling waiting rooms for external client calls but not internal team meetings.

faqs.question: Does GAIA work with Google Meet as well as Zoom?
faqs.answer: GAIA can work with both. You can configure it to use Google Meet for internal meetings and the standalone video app for external ones, based on attendee domains or calendar tags.

faqs.question: Will GAIA notify all attendees when a meeting is created or updated?
faqs.answer: The calendar handles attendee notifications for event updates. GAIA updates the event with the meeting details, and the calendar's standard invitation flow notifies attendees automatically.
